# B-roll beside the speaker

Motion B-roll timed to the speaker's words: two transparent card panels in the empty right side of the frame, never on the speaker, and one full-frame cutaway for the line about automation. The speaker is a synthetic figure and the audio is a generated voice-like tone track that follows the captions; there is no real speech.

- Type: B-roll over a speaker
- Skill: `magnifito-broll`
- Engine: `motion + broll`
- Output: 1920x1080, 15 s, with audio
- Video: [`../videos/07-broll.mp4`](../videos/07-broll.mp4)
- Footage: synthetic, generated by the commands below. No camera footage is used.

## Recreate it with Claude Code

Install the plugin (see the repository README), open this folder, and give Claude this prompt:

> Here is a 15-second talking-head clip of our presenter (work/source.mp4) and its captions (captions.srt). Add Magnifito motion B-roll to it, 1920x1080. She stands on the left, so put transparent panels in the empty right side and keep them off her face and off the burned-in captions. Use a card for “websites, social media, email and ads, all in one plan”, a full-frame cutaway for “then we automate the follow-up”, and a card for what happens to every new lead. Use our brand.json, take every row from what she says and do not invent any numbers. Render a review preview and a contact sheet, and check the sheet before you hand it over.

## Recreate it by hand

From the repository root, one command renders this example exactly as committed:

```sh
npm run showcase -- 07-broll
```

Or run the steps yourself from `showcase/07-broll/` (after `npm run build && npm link`):

```sh
mgvideo broll words captions.srt -o work/transcript.json --txt work/words.txt
node make-footage.mjs
mgvideo broll check plan.json
mgvideo broll render plan.json --pages work/pages
mgvideo broll compose plan.json work/preview.mp4 --sheet work/contact.png
```

The finished file is `work/preview.mp4`. The config files in this folder are the inputs.
